title: Wapira's Crown
summary: Healing another creature restores 1d6 HP to the wearer.

fields.Crowning Glory: Triggers when you heal another creature. Self-healing cannot trigger it.
fields.Acquisition: After saving the refugees, accept Zevlor’s monetary reward and open the Patched-Together Sack. If declined, buy it from Zevlor before the next Long Rest. Leading Minthara to attack the grove removes the reward.
fields.Base value: 90 gp in BG3. Merchant prices vary.

changes: Added native BG3 gameplay and acquisition details with pinned source evidence.
